clue.text: Midget's mouth treated by doctor following bit of trouble

indicators.note: a bit of a word is just a scrap of it, here its opening letter

parts.note: the first letter of trouble

indicators.note: something treated is worked on and altered, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, then rearranged
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: A small person's sore mouth is seen to by a doctor after some bother.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Following' places the reworked mouth and the doctor after the opening T. The 's is read as 'is', joining definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Tom Thumb is the tiny hero of an English folk tale, and his name became a byword for any very small person.

clue.text: Navigator volunteers on South Island

parts.note: the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve force
S is the compass abbreviation for south
the Isle of Man, in the Irish Sea

explanation.surface: A sailor relies on volunteer helpers on New Zealand's South Island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'South Island' looks like New Zealand's island, fitting the navigator, but splits into S and the Isle of Man.
explanation.definitionFit: Abel Tasman was the Dutch seafarer who charted Tasmania and New Zealand in the 1640s.

clue.text: Evangelist — second one to carry one

parts.note: a mo is a moment, a second

indicators.note: to carry something is to hold it inside, so one word goes within the other

parts.note: taken as written, the carrier
the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A preacher's sidekick has the job of carrying someone.
explanation.walkthrough: The second 'one' becomes the numeral I and sits inside the first, written in full.
explanation.definitionFit: A Moonie is a follower of Sun Myung Moon's Unification Church, famed for zealous recruitment, so a kind of evangelist.

clue.text: Principal's keen to get an advantage

parts.note: a head is a principal of a school; with the 's, head's
tart and keen both mean sharp

explanation.surface: A headteacher is eager to gain an edge.
explanation.walkthrough: Keen here is sharp, as of a taste or blade, not eager.
explanation.definitionFit: A head start is an early lead given or gained at the outset, which is an advantage over rivals.

clue.text: Poet — important one's heading off for town

indicators.note: with its heading off a word loses its first letter

parts.note: John Milton, author of Paradise Lost
key means crucial, important
taken as written, apostrophe dropped

explanation.surface: A poet of standing sets off for a town.
explanation.walkthrough: Ones loses its O. Milton Keynes is a new town in Buckinghamshire, England, famous for its roundabouts and concrete cows.
explanation.definitionFit: Milton Keynes is a large planned town north-west of London, built from the late 1960s.

clue.text: In Gormenghast, he besieges an ancient city

indicators.note: the answer is found in the words that follow, spanning them

parts.note: runs across the end of the first word, all of the second and the start of the third

explanation.surface: In Mervyn Peake's Gormenghast novels, a character lays siege to a city of old.
explanation.definitionFit: Thebes was a great city of ancient Egypt, and also one of ancient Greece.

clue.text: Fish catches in tugs

definitions.meaning: first meaning: amounts of fish taken in a net
second meaning: pulls hard, as a verb

explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures fish caught by tugboats; tugs is in fact a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A haul is a quantity of fish netted, and to haul is to drag or pull with effort.

clue.text: Fetched, mostly before noon, in a carriage

indicators.note: mostly means not quite all, so the final letter is lost

parts.note: fetched means brought
a.m., ante meridiem, before midday

explanation.surface: Someone was collected in a carriage that morning.
explanation.definitionFit: A brougham is a light four-wheeled horse-drawn carriage with an enclosed body, named after Lord Brougham.

clue.text: Wave holding one Italian mushroom

indicators.note: holding means keeping something inside, so the other pieces sit within

parts.note: to wave a fist is to shake it
the Roman numeral for one
It is the short form of Italian vermouth

explanation.surface: A greeting gesture encompasses one Italian fungus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Italian mushroom' reads as one phrase, but Italian only supplies the abbreviation from Italian vermouth, and the mushroom is Japanese.
explanation.definitionFit: Shiitake is an edible brown fungus grown on logs, widely used in East Asian cooking.

clue.text: Short note about article written by old boy in Brazilian city

indicators.note: about means going around, so the note surrounds what follows

parts.note: soh, a note of the sol-fa scale, cut short
the indefinite article
a boy's name
O is a standard abbreviation for old

explanation.surface: A brief message about an article by a former pupil in a city in Brazil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old boy' looks like a former pupil but splits into O and a boy's name, which go after S-A-O. SAO PAULO is South America's largest city.
explanation.definitionFit: São Paulo is the largest city in Brazil and the capital of the state of the same name.

clue.text: Ghouls I played, Hungary departed?

indicators.note: played suggests acting in a new way, so the letters are rearranged
something departed has left, so that letter is taken out of the group

parts.note: taken as written
H is the international vehicle code for Hungary

explanation.surface: A horror actor confesses to playing ghouls after leaving his Hungarian homeland.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is a description of the actor: he played horror roles and left Hungary for Hollywood, while the wordplay drops H from the letters before rearranging.
explanation.definitionFit: Bela Lugosi, born in Hungary, emigrated to America and became famous playing Dracula and other monsters.

clue.text: See ten airmen flying in part of France

indicators.note: flying suggests things tossed about in the air and landing in a new order

parts.note: taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: Watch a squadron of ten pilots flying over a French region.
explanation.definitionFit: Seine-et-Marne is a département of the Île-de-France region, east of Paris.

clue.text: House changes when leader's not there

indicators.note: with the leader absent the front letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: changes means varies

explanation.surface: A household is transformed whenever its head is away.
explanation.walkthrough: House here is astrological: the zodiac is divided into twelve houses.
explanation.definitionFit: In astrology, Aries is the first sign of the zodiac, and each sign is linked with one of the twelve houses.

clue.text: Mistake as regards judgment

parts.note: over means about, concerning, as in 'a row over money'
sight means view or opinion, as in 'in the sight of God'

explanation.surface: An error is made in assessing something.
explanation.definitionFit: An oversight is a slip made by failing to notice something, so an unintentional error.

clue.text: Plankton-eater lying in the warmth by quiet vessel

parts.note: basking is lying in the sun
sh is the call for quiet
Noah's vessel

explanation.surface: A sea creature sunbathes beside a silent boat.
explanation.definitionFit: The basking shark, the second-largest fish, feeds by filtering plankton from the water.

clue.text: Awareness shown by one during prison term

indicators.note: during places something inside a span of time, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: the time a convict serves
the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone shows insight while doing time.
explanation.definitionFit: Sentience is the capacity to perceive and feel, a basic state of consciousness.

clue.text: Blemish full of bother? Make-up's required

indicators.note: full of means filled with, so the other piece goes inside

parts.note: a small growth on the skin
a pain is a nuisance, a bother

explanation.surface: An annoying skin spot needs to be covered with cosmetics.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface hints at concealer; the definition is the face paint of warriors, also slang for heavy make-up.
explanation.definitionFit: War paint is the pigment warriors daubed before battle, and jokingly any heavy cosmetics.

clue.text: Monk in carriage tips freely

parts.note: a trap is a light two-wheeled horse carriage

indicators.note: freely means without constraint, so the letters move about at will

parts.note: taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: A cleric riding in a coach hands out gratuities generously.
explanation.definitionFit: A Trappist is a monk of the Cistercian order of strict observance, known for silence.

clue.text: An attractive girl with a lot of money

parts.note: the indefinite article
pretty means attractive
a girl's name

explanation.surface: A good-looking young woman is wealthy.
explanation.definitionFit: A pretty penny is an idiom for a large sum, as in 'that cost a pretty penny'.

clue.text: Girl, Welsh one, cuddled by another

indicators.note: something cuddled is held in someone's arms, so it goes inside the other name

parts.note: another girl's name, the container
W is the abbreviation for Welsh
the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A girl from Wales is hugged by a friend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Another' means another girl, whose name does the cuddling.
explanation.definitionFit: Edwina is a girl's name, the feminine form of Edwin.

clue.text: Girl had pen, ornate

indicators.note: ornate means elaborately decorated, so the letters are worked into a fancier pattern

parts.note: taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: A young woman owned a fancy fountain pen.
explanation.definitionFit: Daphne is a girl's name, from the nymph of Greek myth who became a laurel tree.

clue.text: Sherlock's flight of fancy, Philip read out, involves oriental maiden?

parts.note: Pip is a short form of Philip, as in Great Expectations

indicators.note: to involve is to wrap up within, so the pair surrounds the mixed letters
out suggests something put out of order, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, then rearranged
M is the cricket scorer's abbreviation for a maiden over
E is the abbreviation for eastern

explanation.surface: Holmes's fantasy, recited by Philip, features a girl from the East.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Read out' looks like reciting aloud, but out is an anagram signal. Sherlock Holmes's pipe makes the definition playful.
explanation.definitionFit: A pipe dream is an unrealistic hope, originally the fancy of an opium smoker; Sherlock's suggests his famous pipe.

clue.text: Rubbish left out in avenue

indicators.note: out means removed, so that letter is taken away

parts.note: drivel is nonsense, rubbish
L is the abbreviation for left

explanation.surface: Litter has been dumped in a tree-lined street.
explanation.walkthrough: Rubbish looks like litter in the street, but it is nonsense talk here.
explanation.definitionFit: Drive is used in street names for a residential road, just as avenue is.

clue.text: Home help returns from Asian country

parts.note: in means at home

indicators.note: returns means comes back, so the word is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: aid means help

explanation.surface: A domestic helper comes back from Asia.
explanation.walkthrough: Home help suggests a cleaner; it splits into in and the reversed help.
explanation.definitionFit: India is a large country in South Asia.

clue.text: Complaint — girl stifles it

indicators.note: to stifle is to smother, wrapping around and holding inside

parts.note: a girl's name
taken as written

explanation.surface: A grumble: a girl suppresses the thing.
explanation.definitionFit: Iritis is inflammation of the iris of the eye, a medical complaint, aptly built around a girl named Iris.

clue.text: Exhibit British salad vegetable planted round the North

parts.note: B is an abbreviation for British

indicators.note: planted round means set in the ground about something, enclosing it

parts.note: a red root eaten in salads
N is the compass abbreviation for north

explanation.surface: Show off home-grown radishes sown up north.
explanation.definitionFit: To brandish is to wave something about for all to see, a flamboyant way to show it.

clue.text: Sway scrap dealer

definitions.meaning: second meaning: British slang for a rag-and-bone man

explanation.walkthrough: A totter in British slang is a rag-and-bone man, who collects and sells scrap, from tot, a piece of salvaged junk.
explanation.definitionFit: To totter is to wobble unsteadily, and a totter is also someone who collects and trades discarded goods.

clue.text: Demote King's English ambassador

parts.note: R for Rex, Latin for king
E is the abbreviation for English
a legate is an envoy, especially of the Pope

explanation.surface: The monarch's English envoy is downgraded.
explanation.definitionFit: To relegate is to move someone to a lower rank or division, as with football teams going down.
